subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Which gateway/session activity contract should become the source of truth for the compact Control UI run-progress surface requested here?
rationale: The requested UI needs state beyond current status and hasActiveRun, while open issues and PRs propose competing API, event, and display boundaries that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Canonicalize session activity first
options.body: Use the broader per-session activity API/statechange design as the source of truth, then build this issue's compact Control UI strip on top of it.

options.title: Narrow an open PR into the landing path
options.body: Adopt one of the open implementation PRs only after trimming it to the agreed API and UX boundary with upgrade-safe proof.

options.title: Defer the progress strip
options.body: Keep the current coarse status UI until maintainers are ready to own the broader session activity semantics.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize session activity first
recommendation.body: Use the broader per-session activity API/statechange design as the source of truth, then build this issue's compact Control UI strip on top of it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-path history across the Control UI chat status and gateway sessions.list code that this decision would affect.
